what_differs: The three go-live milestones are still Open with due dates of 2026-07-31, 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-17, and WAGR-23 is framed as a 'Phase 1' go-live whose latest comment recommends a Phase 1a/1b split. Meetings on Aug 11 and Sep 1 decided no parallel run and one November go-live that includes multiple phases with UAT before it; on Sep 25 the client called Nov 1 a hard date.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: when WAGR-475 decides the Nov 1 cut, re-date WAGR-15/17/23 (or replace them), retitle WAGR-23 to the single go-live, add a comment that the 1a/1b split was not adopted (Aug 11 / Sep 1), and link all three to WAGR-475.
